content: स्फीत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [स्फाय्-क्त स्फीभावः] .²1 Swollen, increased; अनुजनिधनस्फीताच्छोकादतिप्रणयाच्च तत् <ls>Ve. 5. 40</ls>. .²2 Fat, thick, big, large, bulky. .²3 Many, numerous, much, copious, plentiful, abundant. .²4 Delighted, joyful. .²5 Pure; मृद्वीका रसिता सिता समशिता स्फीतं निपीतं पयः <ls>Bv. 4. 13</ls>. .²6 Successful, prosperous, thriving. .²7 Affected by hereditary disease. .²8 Dilated; कौतूहलात् स्फीततरैश्च नेत्रैः <ls>Bu. Ch. 3. 10</ls>. (स्फीतीकृ means ‘to augment or enlarge’.)
